Witness Wit_GuardLateMarker (C2 and coercion, causal): EXPECTED VIOLATION, 8 states: StartAttempt, StartExec, Guard while the admission call is in flight, THAT AdmitTxn commits afterwards and inserts the marker (answer ignored), Complete unsent, Apply stopped, EndCall coerces not_dispatched to interrupted; nothing sent.

note: Module RecipientExposureSpec (spec-first, exposure protocol r2; amendment a1).
